title: Defending Bix against rumors; Dorothy Baker and the Man with the Horn
summary: Moore insists Bix was not homosexual, never married and lived for music, and recounts Bob Crosby introducing him to Dorothy Baker, who said the novel was only inspired by Bix's playing.
